lines.1: 「In fact, I only accepted because it was you. I would ordinarily refuse such an arrangement.」
lines.3: 「We knew each other when we were young, and above all, we are family.」
lines.4: 「Cherish your blood. That's the Kurogane code.」
lines.6: 「But what if something happened between us?」
lines.9: then, apparently finding it terribly funny, began to chuckle.
lines.11: 「It is utterly impossible for me to see you as a man. Rest easy.」
lines.12: 「To me, you are more like a younger brother.」
lines.13: That was its own kind of complicated for a man's heart.
lines.14: 「What if I attacked you like a wild beast?」
lines.15: 「You are far too timid to do such a thing.」
lines.16: 「Still, you are welcome to try. I will naturally fight back.」
lines.17: 「I have not trained so feebly that a man could pin me down. You have no chance.」
lines.18: 「If you did attempt it, the price would be... Yes, I would take one of your fingers.」
lines.19: 「...I won't attack you, so please don't worry.」
lines.20: 「Good. That is wise. You are weak.」
lines.21: 「Still, you could've told me in advance instead of showing up like some hidden-camera prank.」
lines.22: 「I tried to tell you several times. You fled on every occasion.」
lines.24: 「I also called last night, but the line was busy the entire time.」
lines.25: That was because Crab was using the internet.
lines.26: 「Do you always spend so long on the telephone?」
lines.27: 「Sorry, that was the internet. We still have a dial-up connection.」
lines.28: 「...Hmm. I do not understand this internet business very well.」
lines.30: 「I'm going to call my parents and confirm it with them.」
lines.31: Please, let this all be some kind of mistake.
